summary: Tested the Future Skills CRM lead-assignee feature on both backend and frontend. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass. They cover the assignees endpoint, the assign rules (self-assign, 403 when grabbing someone else's lead, hand-over, unassign, admin reassign, 400 for an unknown assignee or invalid entity, 404 for a missing record), list scoping for members across leads/trials/subscriptions/renewals/lost, ?assignee filters, lead->trial carry-over, lead reassign propagating to the trial, and stats. Frontend (admin): the Assignee column and buttons show on all 5 tabs, the popover search works, assigning shows the toast and updates the label, 'Unassign' appears only once a row is assigned, and the toolbar filter has 13 options (all/me/unassigned plus members) and filters correctly. Frontend (member1): the lead assigned to member2 is hidden, the filter offers only the 3 base options, hand-over to member2 shows the toast, the row turns into a locked pill and disappears after refresh. All test data was cleaned up.

minor.endpoint: DELETE /api/admin/future-skills/leads/{id}, DELETE /api/admin/future-skills/{entity_type}/{id}, POST leads/{id}/convert-to-trial, mark-lost, PUT lead/trial update, trial attend etc.
minor.issue: These endpoints don't check who the lead is assigned to. Verified: fs.member2 deleted a lead assigned to fs.member1 (got 200). Only /assign and the list endpoints enforce ownership. A regular member who knows a lead's id can still change or delete someone else's lead.

ui_bugs.issue: After a member hands a lead to someone else, the row stays in the list until refresh. It shows the locked pill, but the Trial/Followup/Lost action buttons are still active. Minor; could remove the row optimistically.

action_items: Optional hardening: add an assignee-ownership check for non-managers (current assignee_id must be empty or user.id) to the delete, convert, mark-lost, update and attend endpoints for leads/trials/subscriptions, and to GET-by-id detail endpoints if any
Optional: when a non-manager hands a lead to someone else, remove the row or disable its row actions
critical_code_review_comments: _is_admin lets any @oll.co email into the gate, so every staff member is a 'member'. This is by design, but combined with the unscoped mutation endpoints it widens access.
future_skills.py is over 4100 lines and should be split into modules.

admin_fs_assign uses update_one and does not re-check the current assignee in the same query (there is a race between find_one and update_one). Consider adding {'assignee_id': current} to the update filter for non-managers.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ leads and a converted trial were created and then deleted. The pre-existing 'TEST Child A' trial was left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is POST /api/auth/login, which returns access_token. The UI login page is /admin/login (admin-email, admin-password, admin-submit). The generic delete uses singular entity names: /api/admin/future-skills/{lead|trial|customer}/{id}. member1 id is 3a4a0243-..., member2 id is b78b6c87-....
